headline: Nvidia-backed AI startup Reflection is preparing to release a powerful open-weight model made in the United States, Axios has reported.
score_reason: Pool 8 lowered by 1: an unnamed-source scoop relayed second hand, with no model name, date or benchmarks yet.
importance_line: Companies that want cheap, self-run AI could get a US-made alternative to Chinese open models, though the model is reported to trail the best US systems and nothing has been released yet.
summary: Axios reports, citing sources, that Reflection, a startup backed by chipmaker Nvidia, is about to launch an open-weight model, meaning one whose trained parameters are published so others can run and adapt it. The model is expected to trail the leading US systems but compete with the best Chinese open-weight models, which dominate this field today; Reflection has also signed server-leasing deals with Nebius and SpaceX and a sovereign AI project with Korea's Shinsegae Group.
notes: Axios page blocked; text read in Digital Today's relay of the Axios report. url is the Axios original.
